title: Launch HN: ProvenMetal (YC S26) delivers circuit boards in days instead of weeks
summary: ProvenMetal is a Y Combinator S26 startup that provides rapid domestic PCB manufacturing, delivering assembled circuit boards in days instead of weeks. They aim to rebuild the declining US PCB supply chain, which has dropped from 30% to just 4% of global production over the past two decades, while China dominates at 55%.
problem_solved: Addresses the critical shortage of domestic PCB manufacturing capacity and long lead times that force US companies to wait weeks for overseas production.
why_valuable: Enables hardware startups and companies to rapidly prototype and iterate on electronic products domestically, reducing time-to-market from weeks to days while building supply chain resilience.
